page.overview:
Who is Calder Brya?

Calder Byra was a blue-eyed socialite connected to the planet Coruscant's high society.

Calder Brya was a young Human male socialite with connections to the highest levels of society on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant. A rich man of noble birth, he had over one million credits in his bank account and was also a shockball player.

Brya had brown hair, blue eyes, light skin, and a fit and trim build. He was also considered good-looking. Byra had the natural gift of connecting with people, and despite being the type of rich socialite people loved to hate, his worst critics walked away with a positive outlook on him. Byra's sense of humor was self-deprecating and disarming.

The socialite could speak, read, and write with the Basic, Huttese, and Ryl languages. He also spoke Rodese, though could not read or write it.
